sloka: प्रीतो ऽस्मि परमोदार त्वं कर्ता ऽसि न संशयः ।दण्डेन च प्रजा रक्ष मा च दण्डमकारणे ।। ७.७९.८ ॥
transliteration: prīto 'smi paramodāra tvaṁ kartā 'si na saṁśayaḥ ।daṇḍena ca prajā rakṣa mā ca daṇḍamakāraṇe ।। 7.79.8 ॥

translations.english: Manu said, "O most generous one, I am pleased; you are indeed the creator, of this there is no doubt; protect the subjects with justice, but do not inflict punishment without cause."
